title: 資料撮影用Playwright・Chromiumのインストール
purpose: 操作元MacでHTMLの実表示を確認し、各ステップのPNGと報告用PDFを作る。エッジ側の依存ではない。
expect: Playwright 1.56.1と専用headless Chromiumをプロジェクトのartifacts内へ配置する。
script_text:
set -euxo pipefail
# This step runs on the operator Mac, not on the edge PC.
npm install --prefix research/edge-setup/artifacts/report-renderer --no-audit --no-fund playwright@1.56.1
export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$PWD/research/edge-setup/artifacts/report-renderer/browsers"
node research/edge-setup/artifacts/report-renderer/node_modules/playwright/cli.js install chromium --only-shell
node research/edge-setup/artifacts/report-renderer/node_modules/playwright/cli.js --version
